config.ctcScore: torch ctc_loss over the CTC head's log-probs, blank last, summed over alignments

exposed: per window: the labelled text, its one-edit control and its shifted control; never the label type

rule.pairwise: claimed - alternative >= margin -> match, <= -margin -> mismatch, else unsure; no CTC path for one side decides against it; the labelled text and its one-edit control are each other's alternative; shifted vs labelled
rule.nearBest: claimed >= CTC greedy path - margin -> match, else mismatch
rule.spellings: diac: core.diacritised_candidates against the window's CTC greedy text and RNNT transcript (harakat kept, Quranic marks dropped, characters outside the tokenizer dropped); plain: core.plain_candidates; max over spellings
